title: Grainfather Brew Session Brewhouse Efficiency Leaderboard
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=grainfather:brew efficiency_pct=*
| stats sum(efficiency_pct) as total_value, avg(efficiency_pct) as avg_value by recipe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipe values by total and average brewhouse efficiency across Grainfather brew session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `efficiency_pct` values for each Grainfather brew session event and review total and average brewhouse efficiency by recipe.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total brewhouse efficiency.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which recipe shows the biggest brewhouse efficiency numbers in your Grainfather brew session data.
